needed.evidence: A wide grass verge runs from the road edge to the houses with no paved or trodden path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous concrete footway along the left verge to provide a safe, level route for residents.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is an open grassy area with no defined path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Install a paved footway on the right side to separate pedestrians from the carriageway.

needed.evidence: Houses are present on both sides of the street, creating a need to cross, but there is no marked or physical crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Provide a raised crossing or marked zebra crossing at a central point to allow safe passage between the houses.

needed.evidence: No street lamps are visible along the residential street in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of LED street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for evening travel.
